JS references and explicit Dispose boundaries represent native object identity/destructors without allocator, weak or reference-count machinery. Invalid native assertion preconditions use host errors; no release-mode undefined behavior or post-destruction use is promised. Full styles/pool/Calc document/UI/ODS remain pending; no broad semantic parity promotion.

gaps: Native ABI, mutex concurrency, debug backtraces, undefined invalid indices/pointers and use after native destruction are outside the browser contract.
The native ostream diagnostic hint-ID formatter is not implemented; native consumers use GetId.
Full stylesheet pools, Calc document/UI and same-model ODS are not implemented by this task.
